transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2027-04-08
Time: 15:00 UTC
Duration: ~49 minutes
Attendees: Alex Chen (Redwood AE), Priya Rao (Redwood SE), Jordan Blake (Horizon Tech - Head of ML), Maria Lopez (Horizon Tech - VP Product), Samir Patel (Horizon Tech - Infra Lead)

Summary (auto): Renewal discussion for Horizon Tech's Redwood account. Customer evaluating dedicated/reserved capacity, adding two regions, pricing/discounts tied to 12-month commit, and security/audit checks. Redwood to run perf benchmarks; legal to review contract extension.

[00:00] Alex: hey everyone thanks for joining, uh this is Alex from Redwood, i have Priya here as well our solutions eng, um i saw the invite thanks for making time
[00:09] Jordan: yeah thanks Alex, morning from our side, quick intros, i'm Jordan, i run ML infra, Maria is product, Samir is infra so that's the crew
[00:18] Maria: hi all, thanks
[00:20] Priya: hi!
[00:22] Alex: quick agenda, renewal timing, capacity upgrade options (dedicated), adding eu-west and ap-south regions, security ask, and next steps. sound good?
[00:31] Jordan: yep, let's go

-- Renewal & business context --
[00:45] Alex: so, high level we've seen your usage ramp, right? last qtr token growth ~2.3x, the billing team flagged you for renewal starting june. you had asked about reserved capacity to stabilize latency and cost, is that still the ask?
[00:58] Jordan: yep, exactly. we're pretty happy with the hosted latency overall but occasional spikes during batch jobs are a pain, and the unit cost when we scale is getting rough. so dedicated pools sounds attractive for steady state and to guarantee throughput during peak inference.
[01:10] Priya: to add, dedicated pools can be sized with autoscale and burst. we recommend a baseline pool to hit your p95 latency target and a burst buffer for traffic spikes that usually lowers unit cost by 20-35% depending on utilization.
[01:24] Maria: real quick we need two additional regions live: eu-west for EU customers and ap-south for APAC pilots. timelines wise we'd prefer both in Q3 if possible. how realistic is that?
[01:37] Alex: eu-west is straightforward, we can spin Dedicated clusters there within a couple weeks after contract. ap-south has some supply constraints but tentatively Q3 is doable, pending capacity availability.

-- Security & compliance --
[01:52] Samir: on security, our compliance team needs to re-validate SOC2, plus we have KMS requirements and want full audit logs for all inference requests. is that all standard on Redwood Dedicated / Private?
[02:03] Priya: yes Dedicated supports KMS integrations and audit logging. we do SOC2 and we can provide the report and the attestation. for on-prem or VPC we have a private control plane option if you need air-gapped. we'll share the security pack.
[02:17] Jordan: can you send the SOC2 auditor contact? we re-run the vendor assessment.
[02:21] Alex: yes, we'll do that Priya i'll flag the SOC2 contact in the notes.

-- Pricing / contract --
[02:31] Alex: for pricing, we modeled a 12-month renewal with reserved capacity (x-large pool) plus two region add-ons. there's a commit discount we can apply if you sign for 12 months vs month-to-month. curious what internal approvals you need?
[02:45] Maria: finance wants a single PO and legal needs to sign off on data residency clauses. Also product asks that we keep a fallback to hosted API during outages basically automatic routing to hosted if Dedicated pool is saturated.
[02:56] Priya: that's supported. we have smart routing and automatic fallback to compatible model variants/hosted tier it can be part of the rollout policy in the config.

-- Technical questions and benchmarks --
[03:10] Jordan: i want to see benchmarks at our target sequences we're doing a lot of 6k seq tokenization for long-context analytics. previously some of the numbers in your public benchmarks were on 2k seq, can you replicate 6k with our model family and show p95/p99 and throughput?
[03:24] Priya: yes, we can run a dedicated 48-hour soak with 6k sequences, simulate your burst patterns (200 qps burst, baseline 20 qps) and share the full traces. note that with kv cache and prefix caching enabled, effective latency usually improves for conversational reuse.
[03:40] Jordan: is there any change to the inference runtime when we go from hosted to dedicated? i.e., will kernels or quantization differ and affect outputs?
[03:47] Priya: functionally no we use the same model weights and quant profiles. runtime chooses optimized kernels per hardware, but deterministic outputs remain consistent within quantization tolerances. occasional token-level diffs can happen across kernels but we track quality in our evals.
[04:02] Maria: okay good.

-- Objections / tradeoffs --
[04:08] Jordan: our main hesitation is the commitment length if traffic drops we don't want to be stuck paying for unused reserved capacity.
[04:15] Alex: fair. we offer flexible reserved tiers + a burst buffer that reduces the effective committed amount. also we can do a blended rate: initial three months at a pilot discounted rate while you validate, then move to full reserved pricing. we can add a usage true-up clause.
[04:30] Samir: will switching to Dedicated require network changes? we have strict egress policies and VPC peering rules.
[04:37] Priya: for Dedicated in a cloud region we can set up VPC peering or private link; we can walk your infra team through routing and firewall rules. for private/on-prem we have more hands-on support. we'll schedule that deep-dive.

-- Recap & Next steps --
[04:55] Alex: recap you want a 12-month renewal with reserved Dedicated pool, add eu-west and ap-south, run 48-hour perf benchmark at 6k seq, share SOC2 docs, and we'll send a revised quote. If benchmarks look good and legal signs off, target go-live in Q3.
[05:12] Jordan: correct. also would like p95 < 200ms for our shorter requests and p95 < 700ms for full 6k sequences as our internal SLA target can you note those?
[05:25] Priya: noted we'll aim to capture both.
[05:28] Maria: timeline for quote?
[05:30] Alex: i can get an updated quote and region add-ons to you by monday 2027-04-11.
[05:35] Samir: i'll gather the SOC2 contact and compliance list and share by tuesday.
[05:39] Jordan: once we get the perf report we will try to finalize the PO quickly.

-- Closing noise and misc bits (transcription artefacts) --
[05:45] Speaker 1: mm-hmm, uh-huh
[05:48] Alex: ok great thanks everyone, we'll follow up in notes, priya will run the bench, alex will send quote, samir will send security contact. meeting adjourned

References/Links mentioned: "Renewal quote draft (will be shared)", "Security pack (SOC2) link to be uploaded", "Benchmark harness spreadsheet (internal)"

End of transcript.
